_comment: Typical real-world heights in metres, used only for the APPROXIMATE distance spoken as 'about N metres'. Keys are class IDs from class_names.json; display names also work. null disables the estimate for that class. These are rough averages, not measurements - check them against your own camera and objects.
_vertical_fov_note: The camera is assumed to have a 60 degree vertical field of view. Change it with --vertical-fov if your camera differs.
